mainText:
Good afternoon. Weather in Prishtina: 9 degrees now, light rain. Next 24 hours: high 12, low 4.

Norwegian low-cost carrier Norse Atlantic has cancelled all Thursday flights and faces a bankruptcy threat as financial difficulties and rising costs mount.

Albanian MP Elisa Spiropali, expelled from the Socialist Party, has been reassigned to the back row of the parliament chamber, sitting alongside opposition members.

Elon Musk announced he will give every child in the United States two shares of his SpaceX company, effectively doubling the value of a typical child's stock grant.

Arsenal defender Cristhian Mosquera is expected to leave the club in the January transfer window as part of a proposed swap deal with Inter Milan, a move that could weaken the Gunners' defense.

Lirie Namani, originally from the village of Kapit i Medvegjës, earned a doctorate in Educational-Science from the University of Geneva, marking a notable academic achievement for the Albanian diaspora.
